title: Rockstar Reveals Even More GTA 6 Screenshots as PS5 Release Draws Closer
text: Rockstar Reveals Even More GTA 6 Screenshots as PS5 Release Draws Closer | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 Grand Theft Auto GTA Rockstar Reveals Even More GTA 6 Screenshots as PS5 Release Draws Closer Check them all out here by Liam Croft 7 hours ago Share: You're exactly two weeks away from playing GTA 6 . To celebrate the fact, developer Rockstar has shared another batch of screenshots that are designed to showcase Vice City at its best, and the world beyond. Take a look below at a whopping 37 new screenshots: GTA 6 comes to PS5 on 19th November 2026, but you can get your preload started from 10th November. Learn more in our GTA 6 Release Times and Preload guide , which is staying up to date as we near launch. A lot of the images focus on protagonists Jason and Lucia, but we do catch glimpses of other characters, the nightlife, and more that'll be part of Leonida. What's your favourite picture? Share it in the comments below. Subscribe to Push Square on YouTube 172k [source rockstargames.com ] Share: 6 43 About Liam Croft Liam grew up with a PlayStation controller in his hands and a love for Metal Gear Solid. Nowadays, he's found playing the latest and greatest PS5 games as well as supporting Derby County. That last detail is his downfall. I do have to say, I wonder whether it will live up to the hype, and also whether it will get fantastic 10/10 reviews whilst at the same time numerous issues with the game are pointed out? I wonder whether professional reviewers will feel compelled to give the game 10/10s, or whether it will deserve them, and whether those same issues in another game would see it marked down? In other words, is the game too big to be critiqued properly? I'm sure the game will be good, but will it be as good as we will be led to believe? I hope it is for the sake of all those that are really looking forward to it, but as someone on the outside of the hype, the excitement is kind of bewildering.
